prompt: From his boxing guard he plants both feet wide and lowers his center of gravity. He draws both clenched gloves down beside his hips with elbows bent outward, tightens his whole torso and lifts his chest and chin in an intense sustained power-up strain. Hold this powerful grounded charging stance with subtle muscular trembling and rhythmic breathing, then ease back to the original guard. Feet stay planted. No punch, no dash, no projectile, no transformation, no costume or hair change. Keep the same body proportions and identity throughout.
